summary: The diff implements all three requirements: REQ-1 (Jamendo API rewrite), REQ-2 (fallback tracks), and REQ-3 (hook/page updates). The implementation is largely complete and well-structured. REQ-1 is fully addressed with Jamendo API integration, proper field mapping, and FMA removal. REQ-2 is addressed with a fallback track file using Internet Archive URLs, though the truncated diff prevents full verification of the 20-track minimum count. REQ-3 is addressed through hook and Music page updates that prevent empty state display. One minor hallucination noted: a usingFallback indicator not requested in the spec.

hallucinated_features.description: usingFallback state exposed in useMusicSearch hook and consumed in Music page
hallucinated_features.reason: The requirements do not specify exposing or displaying a 'usingFallback' indicator to the UI. While benign, it is not part of any acceptance criteria.
